The artwork has a `bleed-left` class that tries to make it span the full panel width (extending behind the navbar), but the CSS math is slightly off — the panel has asymmetric padding (`pad-left: 140px` vs `pad-right: 56px`), so the artwork ends up offset to the right rather than properly centered with the title above it. The simplest, cleanest fix is to make the artwork match the title's column width and center with it.

    color: white;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }

  /* Content area — no card, full-bleed */
  .content {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    z-index: 1;
    scroll-padding-left: var(--snap-offset);
  }
  .content::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  /* Spacer pushes the first panel to start at the snap position */
  .content-spacer {
    flex: 0 0 var(--snap-offset);
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .panel {
    flex: 0 0 calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    height: 100vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    scroll-snap-stop: always;
    /* padding-left = bleed + 56 (= navbar-overlap + breathing). With
       padding-right = 56 and panel-inner auto-margins, the inner column
       auto-centers exactly within the visible area (right of navbar). */
    padding: 72px var(--pad-right) 80px var(--pad-left);
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }
  .panel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  .panel-inner {
    max-width: var(--inner-max);
    margin: 0 auto;          /* auto-centers in panel content area */
    will-change: transform;
  }

  /* Sections that bleed across the panel (artwork). The element spans
     panel.left → panel.right, so when the panel is scrolled out the
     gradient fills the navbar area continuously. Inner padding pushes
     the label so it still lines up with the centered title above. */
  .bleed-left {
    /* CSS magic: 50% - 50vw + snap-offset/2 gives the negative-margin
       needed to reach panel.left from any auto-centered child, because
       50% (of parent) sits at the visible-area center. */
    margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    max-width: none;
    padding-left: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    padding-right: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

      const eased = t < 0

      const innerLag = -eased * 70;

      const panelIO = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
            panelIO.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { root: panel, threshold: 0.18 });
      items.forEach(el => { el.classList.add('reveal'); panelIO.observe(el); });
    });
  }
  setupReveal();

  /* ===== Initial loader ===== */
  function hideLoader() {
    const loader = document.getElementById('loader');
    if (!loader) return;
    loader.classList.add('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => { loader.style.display = 'none'; }, 700);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    setTimeout(hideLoader, 900);
  });
  // Fallback in case 'load' already fired
  if (document.readyState === 'complete') setTimeout(hideLoader, 900);

  /* ===== iPadOS-style custom cursor ===== */
  (function initCursor() {
    if (window.matchMedia('(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)').matches) return;
    const shape = document.getElementById('cursorShape');
    const dot = document.getElementById('cursorDot');
    if (!shape || !dot) return;

    let mouseX = window.innerWidth / 2;
    let mouseY = window.innerHeight / 2;
    let shapeX = mouseX, shapeY = mouseY;
    let targetW = 28, targetH = 28, targetR = 50;
    let curW = 28, curH = 28, curR = 50;
    let hoverEl = null;
    let lockToEl = false;

    // Only truly clickable / focusable elements morph the cursor
    const interactiveSel = [
      'a[href]',
      'button',
      'input:not([type="hidden"])',
      'textarea',
      'select',
      '.sidebar-item',
      '.focus-card',
      '.link-pill',
      '.social-btn',
      '.nav-side',
      '.cal-btn',
      '.project-card',
      '.bn-tab',
      '[data-target]:not(.process-step)',
      '[data-scroll-to]',
      '[role="button"]'
    ].join(', ');

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      mouseX = e.clientX;
      mouseY = e.clientY;
      dot.style.left = mouseX + 'px';
      dot.style.top = mouseY + 'px';

      const target = e.target.closest(interactiveSel);
      if (target && target !== hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = target;
        const r = target.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Hug the element fully — no caps. Add a small padding so the cursor
        // sits a couple of pixels outside the element's edges.
        targetW = r.width + 8;
        targetH = r.height + 8;
        // Match element's border-radius where possible
        const cs = getComputedStyle(target);
        let br = parseFloat(cs.borderRadius);
        if (isNaN(br) || br === 0) br = 12;
        const cap = Math.min(targetW, targetH) / 2;
        if (br > cap) br = cap;
        targetR = br;
        shape.classList.add('on-element');
        lockToEl = true;
        // Snap shape to element center for smooth morph
        shapeX = r.left + r.width / 2;
        shapeY = r.top + r.height / 2;
      } else if (!target && hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = null;
        targetW = 22;
        targetH = 22;
        targetR = 50;
        shape.classList.remove('on-element');
        lockToEl = false;
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      document.body.classList.add('cursor-hidden');
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('cursor-hidden');
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
      shape.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.92)';
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      shape.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
    });

    function tick() {
      // Smoothly approach target dimensions
      curW += (targetW - curW) * 0.22;
      curH += (targetH - curH) * 0.22;
      curR += (targetR - curR) * 0.22;

      if (lockToEl && hoverEl && document.contains(hoverEl)) {
        const r = hoverEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Slight magnetic offset toward mouse position within element
        const cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
        const cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
        const offX = (mouseX - cx) * 0.18;
        const offY = (mouseY - cy) * 0.18;
        shapeX += ((cx + offX) - shapeX) * 0.35;
        shapeY += ((cy + offY) - shapeY) * 0.35;
      } else {
        shapeX += (mouseX - shapeX) * 0.22;
        shapeY += (mouseY - shapeY) * 0.22;
      }

      shape.style.width = curW + 'px';
      shape.style.height = curH + 'px';
      // Use percentage of smaller side to keep border-radius proportional
      if (targetR >= 50 - 0.5) {
        shape.style.borderRadius = '50%';
      } else {
        shape.style.borderRadius = curR + 'px';
      }
      shape.style.left = shapeX + 'px';
      shape.style.top = shapeY + 'px';

      // Dot fades slightly when on a button-like element for cleaner look
      dot.classList.toggle('faded', lockToEl);

      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    tick();
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    scroll-snap-stop: always;
    /* padding-left = bleed + 56 (= navbar-overlap + breathing). With
       padding-right = 56 and panel-inner auto-margins, the inner column
       auto-centers exactly within the visible area (right of navbar). */
    padding: 72px var(--pad-right) 80px var(--pad-left);
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;

    max-width: var(--inner-max);

  /* Sections that bleed across the panel (artwork). The element spans
     panel.left → panel.right, so when the panel is scrolled out the
     gradient fills the navbar area continuously. Inner padding pushes
     the label so it still lines up with the centered title above. */
  .bleed-left {
    /* CSS magic: 50% - 50vw + snap-offset/2 gives the negative-margin
       needed to reach panel.left from any auto-centered child, because
       50% (of parent) sits at the visible-area center. */
    margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    max-width: none;
    padding-left: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    padding-right: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

    panels.forEach((p, i) => {
      const pl = p.offsetLeft;
      const pr = pl + p.offsetWidth;
      const overlap = Math.max(0, Math.min(pr, sl + cw) - Math.max(pl, sl));
      if (overlap > bestOverlap) {

        bestIdx = i;

  // Parallax: outgoing panel lags behind (deceleration / repulsion feel),
  // incoming panel slides in slightly delayed too. Multiple layers move at
  // different rates so it feels like depth instead of one rigid block.
  function applyParallax() {
    const sl = content.scrollLeft;
    panels.forEach(panel => {
      if (!panel.offsetWidth) return; // hidden
      const inner = panel.querySelector('.panel-inner');
      if (!inner) return;

      const pl = panel.offsetLeft;
      const pw = panel.offsetWidth;
      const visibleLeft = pl - sl;
      const offset = visibleLeft - snapOffsetCached; // 0 when current

      // Normalised distance (-1 .. 1 across one panel width either side)
      const t = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, offset / pw));
      // ease-out cubic so deceleration is gentle as a panel approaches
      // its snap position from either direction
      const eased = t < 0
        ? -(1 - Math.pow(1 + t, 3))
        :  (1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3));
      // Inner lag — outgoing translates right (positive), upcoming left
      const innerLag = -eased * 70;
      inner.style.transform = `translate3d(${innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;

      // Differential parallax on the artwork (moves slightly faster than
      // surrounding text — creates a subtle depth effect)
      const artwork = panel.querySelector('.artwork');
      if (artwork) {
        const artLag = -eased * 110;
        artwork.style.transform = `translate3d(${artLag - innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;

      // Title nudges in the opposite direction for visual punch
      const title = panel.querySelector('h1.title, h1.page-title, .welcome h1');
      if (title) {
        const titleLag = -eased * 40;
        title.style.transform = `translate3d(${titleLag - innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;
      }
    });
  }

          }

  (function initCursor() {
    if (window.matchMedia('(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)').matches) return;
    const shape = document.getElementById('cursorShape');
    const dot = document.getElementById('cursorDot');
    if (!shape || !dot) return;

    let mouseX = window.innerWidth / 2;
    let mouseY = window.innerHeight / 2;
    let shapeX = mouseX, shapeY = mouseY;
    let targetW = 28, targetH = 28, targetR = 50;
    let curW = 28, curH = 28, curR = 50;
    let hoverEl = null;
    let lockToEl = false;

    // Only truly clickable / focusable elements morph the cursor
    const interactiveSel = [
      'a[href]',
      'button',
      'input:not([type="hidden"])',
      'textarea',
      'select',
      '.sidebar-item',
      '.focus-card',
      '.link-pill',
      '.social-btn',
      '.nav-side',
      '.cal-btn',
      '.project-card',
      '.bn-tab',
      '[data-target]:not(.process-step)',
      '[data-scroll-to]',
      '[role="button"]'
    ].join(', ');

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      mouseX = e.clientX;
      mouseY = e.clientY;
      dot.style.left = mouseX + 'px';
      dot.style.top = mouseY + 'px';

      const target = e.target.closest(interactiveSel);
      if (target && target !== hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = target;

  /* ===== Projects list (deep dive entry on mobile) ===== */
  .panel[data-id="projects-list"] {
    display: none;
  }
  .projects-list-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 12px;

  }
  .pl-card {
    text-align: left;
    background: white;

  .pl-card:hover, .pl-card:focus-visible {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
    border-color: rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.25);

  .pl-card .pl-thumb {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
    border-radius: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: white;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    font-size: 14px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .pl-card .pl-thumb::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 28% 28%, rgba(255,255,255,0.32), transparent 55%);
  }
  .pl-card .pl-thumb span { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .pl-card .pl-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .pl-card .pl-tag { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
  .pl-card .pl-arrow {
    margin-top: 10px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    color: var(--accent);

  }

  @media (max-width: 1100px) {
    .welcome h1 { font-size: 48px; }
    .process-flow { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .process-flow::before { display: none; }
    .focus-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .mini-process { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .impact-bar { grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr 60px; }
  }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    :root {
      --sidebar-width: 0px;
      --sidebar-gap: 0px;
      --bleed: 0px;
      --content-offset: 0px;
      --snap-offset: 0px;
    }
    .sidebar { display: none; }
    .bottom-nav { display: flex; }
    .panel {
      padding: 28px 20px 110px 20px;
      width: 100vw;
      flex: 0 0 100vw;
    }
    .content-spacer { display: none; }
    .panel[data-id="projects-list"] { display: block; }
    .panel-inner { max-width: 100%; }
    h1.title { font-size: 28px; }
    .welcome { min-height: calc(100vh - 180px); gap: 16px; }
    .welcome h1 { font-size: 34px; }
    .welcome .lede { font-size: 16px; }
    .sec { margin-top: 48px; }
    .sec-title { font-size: 22px; }
    .hero { flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; }
    .avatar { width: 64px; height: 64px; font-size: 24px; }
    .outcome-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .image-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .mini-process { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .contact-form .row { flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
    .meta-row { gap: 16px; }
    .projects-list-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    .impact-bar { grid-template-columns: 100px 1fr 56px; gap: 8px; }
    .bleed-left { margin-left: 0; width: 100%; padding-left: 0; }
    .artwork { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 480px) {
    .projects-list-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .welcome h1 { font-size: 28px; }
  }

  /* Floating sidebar — sits ON TOP of the content */
  .sidebar {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(--sidebar-gap);
    left: var(--sidebar-gap);
    bottom: var(--sidebar-gap);
    width: var(--sidebar-width);
    background: var(--sidebar-bg);
    backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(30px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(30px);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    box-shadow: var(--sidebar-shadow);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    padding: 18px 8px 12px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    z-index: 10;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    transition: background 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease, backdrop-filter 0.35s ease;
  }

  body.is-scrolled .sidebar {
    background: var(--sidebar-bg-scrolled);
    box-shadow: var(--sidebar-shadow-scrolled);
    backdrop-filter: saturate(200%) blur(50px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(200%) blur(50px);
  }

  .sidebar-brand {
    padding: 6px 12px 14px;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }

  .sidebar-section-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    padding: 12px 12px 4px;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }

  .sidebar-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 9px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    border-radius: 7px;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 400;
    margin: 1px 4px;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    user-select: none;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .sidebar-item:hover { background: var(--hover); }
  .sidebar-item.active {
    background: var(--active);
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--accent);
  }
  .sidebar-item.active .sidebar-icon { color: var(--accent); }

  .sidebar-icon {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: var(--accent);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .sidebar-icon svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }

  .sidebar-spacer { flex: 1; }

  .sidebar-socials {
    padding: 10px 4px 4px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--divider);
    margin: 8px 8px 0;
  }
  .sidebar-socials-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    padding: 4px 8px 6px;
  }
  .social-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 0 4px 4px;
  }
  .social-btn {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 9px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s, color 0.15s;
  }
  .social-btn:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: white;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
  .social-btn svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }

  /* Content area — no card, full-bleed */
  .content {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    z-index: 1;
    scroll-padding-left: var(--snap-offset);
  }
  .content::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  /* Spacer pushes the first panel to start at the snap position */
  .content-spacer {
    flex: 0 0 var(--snap-offset);
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .panel {
    flex: 0 0 calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    height: 100vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    scroll-snap-stop: always;
    /* padding-left = bleed + 56 (= navbar-overlap + breathing). With
       padding-right = 56 and panel-inner auto-margins, the inner column
       auto-centers exactly within the visible area (right of navbar). */
    padding: 72px var(--pad-right) 80px var(--pad-left);
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }
  .panel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  .panel-inner {
    max-width: var(--inner-max);
    margin: 0 auto;          /* auto-centers in panel content area */
    will-change: transform;
  }

  /* Sections that bleed across the panel (artwork). The element spans
     panel.left → panel.right, so when the panel is scrolled out the
     gradient fills the navbar area continuously. Inner padding pushes
     the label so it still lines up with the centered title above. */
  .bleed-left {
    /* CSS magic: 50% - 50vw + snap-offset/2 gives the negative-margin
       needed to reach panel.left from any auto-centered child, because
       50% (of parent) sits at the visible-area center. */
    margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    max-width: none;
    padding-left: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    padding-right: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  /* Typography */
  .greeting {

    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .eyebrow {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  h1.title {
    font-size: 46px;
    line-height: 1.08;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  h2.section-title {
    font-size: 24px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;

    margin: 40px 0 14px;

  .lede {

  .meta-row {

  .link-pill {

  .link-pill.secondary {

    color: var(--text-primary);
  }
  .actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 8px; }

  /* About hero */
  .hero {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 32px;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }
  .avatar {
    width: 96px;
    height: 96px;
    border-radius: 26%;

  .hero-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

  /* Project hero/artwork */
  .artwork {
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
    border-radius: 22px;
    /* Match the text column width and center horizontally within
       the panel-inner so the artwork aligns with the title/body. */
    width: 100%;
    max-width: var(--inner-max);
    margin-top: 14px;
    margin-right: auto;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
    margin-left: auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: white;
    font-size: 36px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .artwork::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%, rgba(255,255,255,0.32), transparent 55%);
  }
  .artwork span { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

  /* Image placeholders */
  .image-placeholder {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f4f4f6, #e9eaf0);

    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .image-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 14px;
    margin: 14px 0;
  }
  .image-row .image-placeholder { margin: 0; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
  .image-placeholder.tall { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }
  .image-placeholder.wide { aspect-ratio: 21 / 9; }

  /* Process / outcomes lists */
  .pill-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin: 4px 0 22px;
  }
  .pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;

    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;

  /* ===== About page: welcome hero (above the fold) ===== */
  .welcome {
    min-height: calc(100vh - 152px);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 24px;
    padding-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .welcome .wave {

  .welcome h1 .accent-grad {

    background-position: 0% 50%;
    -webkit-background-clip: text;

    color: transparent;

  @keyframes gradient-drift {

    50%  { background-position: 100% 50%; }

  /* ===== Section header (cleaner about sections) ===== */
  .sec {
    margin-top: 80px;

  .sec-eyebrow {

    font-weight: 600;

        const panel = targetEl.closest('.panel');
        if (panel) {
          panel.scrollTo({ top: targetEl.offsetTop - 32, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    const trigger = e.target.closest('[data-target]');
    if (!trigger) return;
    if (trigger.classList.contains('sidebar-item')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const id = trigger.dataset.target;
    scrollToTarget(id);
    setActive(id);
  });

  // Contact form: hand off to user's mail client + show inline confirmation
  window.handleContactSubmit = function(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.target;
    const name = encodeURIComponent(form.name.value || '');
    const email = encodeURIComponent(form.email.value || '');
    const subject = encodeURIComponent(form.subject.value || 'Hello from your portfolio');
    const message = encodeURIComponent(
      (form.message.value || '') +
      '\n\n— ' + (form.name.value || '') +
      '\n' + (form.email.value || '')
    );
    const mailto = `mailto:filipe.eck@gmail.com?subject=${subject}&body=${message}`;
    window.location.href = mailto;
    document.getElementById('formSuccess').classList.add('show');
    return false;
  };

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0.5) {
        setActive(entry.target.dataset.id);
      }
    });
  }, {
    root: content,
    threshold: [0.5, 0.75]
  });
  panels.forEach(p => observer.observe(p));

  function updateScrolled() {
    const horizontallyOffStart = content.scrollLeft > 4;
    const anyVerticallyScrolled = panels.some(p => p.scrollTop > 4);
    document.body.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', horizontallyOffStart || anyVerticallyScrolled);
  }
  content.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrolled, { passive: true });
  panels.forEach(p => p.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrolled, { passive: true }));

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;
    const activeIdx = order.findIndex(id => sidebarItems.find(s => s.dataset.target === id && s.classList.contains('active')));
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && activeIdx < order.length - 1) {
      scrollToTarget(order[activeIdx + 1]); setActive(order[activeIdx + 1]);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && activeIdx > 0) {
      scrollToTarget(order[activeIdx - 1]); setActive(order[activeIdx - 1]);
    }
  });

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    scrollToTarget('about');
    setActive('about');
  });

  /* ===== Active panel + parallax on horizontal scroll ===== */
  function getSnapOffsetPx() {
    const v = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
      .getPropertyValue('--snap-offset')
      .trim();
    // calc() values aren't resolved by getComputedStyle on :root vars in
    // every engine, so fall back to a measured value from the spacer.
    const parsed = parseFloat(v);
    if (!isNaN(parsed) && v.endsWith('px')) return parsed;
    const spacer = document.querySelector('.content-spacer');
    return spacer ? spacer.offsetWidth : 0;
  }

  let snapOffsetCached = getSnapOffsetPx();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    snapOffsetCached = getSnapOffsetPx();
    requestAnimationFrame(applyParallax);
  });

  function syncActivePanelClass() {
    const cw = content.clientWidth;
    const sl = content.scrollLeft;
    let bestIdx = 0;
    let bestOverlap = -1;
    panels.forEach((p, i) => {
      const pl = p.offsetLeft;
      const pr = pl + p.offsetWidth;
      const overlap = Math.max(0, Math.min(pr, sl + cw) - Math.max(pl, sl));
      if (overlap > bestOverlap) {
        bestOverlap = overlap;
        bestIdx = i;
      }
    });
    panels.forEach((p, i) => p.classList.toggle('active', i === bestIdx));
  }

  // Parallax: outgoing panel lags behind (deceleration / repulsion feel),
  // incoming panel slides in slightly delayed too. Multiple layers move at
  // different rates so it feels like depth instead of one rigid block.
  function applyParallax() {
    const sl = content.scrollLeft;
    panels.forEach(panel => {
      if (!panel.offsetWidth) return; // hidden
      const inner = panel.querySelector('.panel-inner');
      if (!inner) return;

      const pl = panel.offsetLeft;
      const pw = panel.offsetWidth;
      const visibleLeft = pl - sl;
      const offset = visibleLeft - snapOffsetCached; // 0 when current

      // Normalised distance (-1 .. 1 across one panel width either side)
      const t = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, offset / pw));
      // ease-out cubic so deceleration is gentle as a panel approaches
      // its snap position from either direction
      const eased = t < 0
        ? -(1 - Math.pow(1 + t, 3))
        :  (1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3));
      // Inner lag — outgoing translates right (positive), upcoming left
      const innerLag = -eased * 70;
      inner.style.transform = `translate3d(${innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;

      // Differential parallax on the artwork (moves slightly faster than
      // surrounding text — creates a subtle depth effect)
      const artwork = panel.querySelector('.artwork');
      if (artwork) {
        const artLag = -eased * 110;
        artwork.style.transform = `translate3d(${artLag - innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;
      }
      // Title nudges in the opposite direction for visual punch
      const title = panel.querySelector('h1.title, h1.page-title, .welcome h1');
      if (title) {
        const titleLag = -eased * 40;
        title.style.transform = `translate3d(${titleLag - innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;
      }
    });
  }

  let parallaxRAF = null;
  function scheduleScrollUpdate() {
    if (parallaxRAF) return;
    parallaxRAF = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      syncActivePanelClass();
      applyParallax();
      parallaxRAF = null;
    });
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    syncActivePanelClass();
    applyParallax();
  });

  /* ===== Scroll reveal observer ===== */
  function setupReveal() {
    const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' });
    revealEls.forEach(el => io.observe(el));

    // Per-panel vertical reveal
    panels.forEach(panel => {
      const items = panel.querySelectorAll('.sec, .focus-card, .skill, .process-step, .image-placeholder, .image-row, .outcome-card, .impact-bar, .mini-process .step, .contact-form, .calendly-card');
      const panelIO = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
            panelIO.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { root: panel, threshold: 0.18 });
      items.forEach(el => { el.classList.add('reveal'); panelIO.observe(el); });
    });
  }
  setupReveal();

  /* ===== Initial loader ===== */
  function hideLoader() {
    const loader = document.getElementById('loader');
    if (!loader) return;
    loader.classList.add('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => { loader.style.display = 'none'; }, 700);

    setTimeout(hideLoader, 900);
  });

  if (document.readyState === 'complete') setTimeout(hideLoader, 900);

  /* ===== iPadOS-style custom cursor ===== */
  (function initCursor() {
    if (window.matchMedia('(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)').matches) return;
    const shape = document.getElementById('cursorShape');
    const dot = document.getElementById('cursorDot');
    if (!shape || !dot) return;

    let mouseX = window.innerWidth / 2;
    let mouseY = window.innerHeight / 2;
    let shapeX = mouseX, shapeY = mouseY;
    let targetW = 28, targetH = 28, targetR = 50;
    let curW = 28, curH = 28, curR = 50;
    let hoverEl = null;
    let lockToEl = false;

    // Only truly clickable / focusable elements morph the cursor
    const interactiveSel = [
      'a[href]',
      'button',
      'input:not([type="hidden"])',
      'textarea',
      'select',
      '.sidebar-item',
      '.focus-card',
      '.link-pill',
      '.social-btn',
      '.nav-side',
      '.cal-btn',
      '.project-card',
      '.bn-tab',
      '[data-target]:not(.process-step)',
      '[data-scroll-to]',
      '[role="button"]'
    ].join(', ');

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      mouseX = e.clientX;
      mouseY = e.clientY;
      dot.style.left = mouseX + 'px';
      dot.style.top = mouseY + 'px';

      const target = e.target.closest(interactiveSel);
      if (target && target !== hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = target;
        const r = target.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Hug the element fully — no caps. Add a small padding so the cursor
        // sits a couple of pixels outside the element's edges.
        targetW = r.width + 8;
        targetH = r.height + 8;
        // Match element's border-radius where possible
        const cs = getComputedStyle(target);
        let br = parseFloat(cs.borderRadius);
        if (isNaN(br) || br === 0) br = 12;
        const cap = Math.min(targetW, targetH) / 2;
        if (br > cap) br = cap;
        targetR = br;
        shape.classList.add('on-element');
        lockToEl = true;
        // Snap shape to element center for smooth morph
        shapeX = r.left + r.width / 2;
        shapeY = r.top + r.height / 2;
      } else if (!target && hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = null;
        targetW = 22;
        targetH = 22;
        targetR = 50;
        shape.classList.remove('on-element');
        lockToEl = false;
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      document.body.classList.add('cursor-hidden');
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('cursor-hidden');
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
      shape.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.92)';
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      shape.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
    });

    function tick() {
      // Smoothly approach target dimensions
      curW += (targetW - curW) * 0.22;
      curH += (targetH - curH) * 0.22;
      curR += (targetR - curR) * 0.22;

      if (lockToEl && hoverEl && document.contains(hoverEl)) {
        const r = hoverEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Slight magnetic offset toward mouse position within element
        const cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
        const cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
        const offX = (mouseX - cx) * 0.18;
        const offY = (mouseY - cy) * 0.18;
        shapeX += ((cx + offX) - shapeX) * 0.35;
        shapeY += ((cy + offY) - shapeY) * 0.35;
      } else {
        shapeX += (mouseX - shapeX) * 0.22;
        shapeY += (mouseY - shapeY) * 0.22;
      }

      shape.style.width = curW + 'px';
      shape.style.height = curH + 'px';
      // Use percentage of smaller side to keep border-radius proportional
      if (targetR >= 50 - 0.5) {
        shape.style.borderRadius = '50%';
      } else {
        shape.style.borderRadius = curR + 'px';
      }
      shape.style.left = shapeX + 'px';
      shape.style.top = shapeY + 'px';

      // Dot fades slightly when on a button-like element for cleaner look
      dot.classList.toggle('faded', lockToEl);

      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    tick();
  })();
</script>
</body>

    .sidebar,

    /* === Stack components vertically === */
    .hero { flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; }
    .avatar { width: 64px; height: 64px; font-size: 24px; }
    .outcome-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .image-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

  /* Content area — no card, full-bleed */
  .content {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    z-index: 1;
    scroll-padding-left: var(--snap-offset);
  }
  .content::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  /* Spacer pushes the first panel to start at the snap position */
  .content-spacer {
    flex: 0 0 var(--snap-offset);
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .panel {
    flex: 0 0 calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    height: 100vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    scroll-snap-stop: always;
    /* padding-left = bleed + 56 (= navbar-overlap + breathing). With
       padding-right = 56 and panel-inner auto-margins, the inner column
       auto-centers exactly within the visible area (right of navbar). */
    padding: 72px var(--pad-right) 80px var(--pad-left);
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }
  .panel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  .panel-inner {
    max-width: var(--inner-max);
    margin: 0 auto;          /* auto-centers in panel content area */
    will-change: transform;
  }

  /* Sections that bleed across the panel (artwork). The element spans
     panel.left → panel.right, so when the panel is scrolled out the
     gradient fills the navbar area continuously. Inner padding pushes
     the label so it still lines up with the centered title above. */
  .bleed-left {
    /* CSS magic: 50% - 50vw + snap-offset/2 gives the negative-margin
       needed to reach panel.left from any auto-centered child, because
       50% (of parent) sits at the visible-area center. */
    margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    max-width: none;
    padding-left: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    padding-right: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

            <button class="nav-side" data-target="${prevId}">
              <div>
                <div class="label">← Previous</div>
                <div class="name">${escapeHtml(prevLabel)}</div>
              </div>
            </button>
            ${nextId ? `
              <button class="nav-side nav-right" data-target="${nextId}">
                <div>
                  <div class="label">Next</div>
                  <div class="name">${escapeHtml(nextLabel)} →</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            ` : `<div></div>`}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    `;
  }

  // Render project panels
  const content = document.getElementById('content');
  const template = document.getElementById('projectTemplate');
  projects.forEach((p, i) => {
    const prevId = i === 0 ? "projects-list" : projects[i - 1].id;
    const nextId = i < projects.length - 1 ? projects[i + 1].id : null;
    template.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', renderProjectPanel(p, prevId, nextId));
  });
  template.remove();

  // Render projects-list cards
  const projectsListGrid = document.getElementById('projectsListGrid');
  if (projectsListGrid) {
    projectsListGrid.innerHTML = projects.map(p => `
      <button class="pl-card" data-target="${p.id}">
        <div class="pl-thumb" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg, ${p.colors[0]}, ${p.colors[1]});">
          <span>${escapeHtml(p.title)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pl-title">${escapeHtml(p.title)}</div>
        <div class="pl-tag">${escapeHtml(p.tagline)}</div>
        <div class="pl-arrow">Open case study →</div>
      </button>
    `).join('');
  }

  const panels = Array.from(content.querySelectorAll('.panel'));
  const sidebarItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-item[data-target]'));

  function scrollToTarget(id) {
    let panel = panels.find(p => p.dataset.id === id);
    if (!panel) return;
    // If panel is hidden at this breakpoint (e.g., projects-list on desktop),
    // fall back to the nearest visible neighbour so navigation never dead-ends.
    if (panel.offsetWidth === 0) {
      const idx = order.indexOf(id);
      let fallback = null;
      for (let i = idx - 1; i >= 0 && !fallback; i--) {
        const c = panels.find(p => p.dataset.id === order[i]);
        if (c && c.offsetWidth > 0) fallback = c;
      }
      if (!fallback) for (let i = idx + 1; i < order.length && !fallback; i++) {
        const c = panels.find(p => p.dataset.id === order[i]);
        if (c && c.offsetWidth > 0) fallback = c;
      }
      if (!fallback) return;
      panel = fallback;
    }
    content.scrollTo({ left: panel.offsetLeft, behavior: 'smooth' });
    panel.scrollTop = 0;
  }

  function setActive(id) {
    sidebarItems.forEach(item => {
      item.classList.toggle('active', item.dataset.target === id);
    });
    // Sync mobile bottom-nav: "About" stays active on the about panel,
    // "Projects" stays active on the list and on any individual project.
    const bnTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.bn-tab');
    bnTabs.forEach(tab => {
      const tabTarget = tab.dataset.bnTarget;
      const isAboutTab = tabTarget === 'about';
      const isProjectsTab = tabTarget === 'projects-list';
      const matches = isAboutTab
        ? id === 'about'
        : (id === 'projects-list' || projects.some(p => p.id === id));
      tab.classList.toggle('active', matches);
    });
  }

  sidebarItems.forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const id = item.dataset.target;
      scrollToTarget(id);
      setActive(id);
    });
  });

  // Bottom-nav (mobile) tabs
  document.querySelectorAll('.bn-tab').forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const id = tab.dataset.bnTarget;
      scrollToTarget(id);
      setActive(id);
    });
  });

  content.addEventListener('click', e => {
    // In-panel anchor: scroll within current panel to an element with a given id
    const scrollTrigger = e.target.closest('[data-scroll-to]');
    if (scrollTrigger) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const targetEl = document.getElementById(scrollTrigger.dataset.scrollTo);
      if (targetEl) {
        const panel = targetEl.closest('.panel');
        if (panel) {
          panel.scrollTo({ top: targetEl.offsetTop - 32, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    const trigger = e.target.closest('[data-target]');
    if (!trigger) return;
    if (trigger.classList.contains('sidebar-item')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const id = trigger.dataset.target;
    scrollToTarget(id);
    setActive(id);
  });

  // Contact form: hand off to user's mail client + show inline confirmation
  window.handleContactSubmit = function(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.target;
    const name = encodeURIComponent(form.name.value || '');
    const email = encodeURIComponent(form.email.value || '');
    const subject = encodeURIComponent(form.subject.value || 'Hello from your portfolio');
    const message = encodeURIComponent(
      (form.message.value || '') +
      '\n\n— ' + (form.name.value || '') +
      '\n' + (form.email.value || '')
    );
    const mailto = `mailto:filipe.eck@gmail.com?subject=${subject}&body=${message}`;
    window.location.href = mailto;
    document.getElementById('formSuccess').classList.add('show');
    return false;
  };

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0.5) {
        setActive(entry.target.dataset.id);
      }
    });
  }, {
    root: content,
    threshold: [0.5, 0.75]
  });
  panels.forEach(p => observer.observe(p));

  function updateScrolled() {
    const horizontallyOffStart = content.scrollLeft > 4;
    const anyVerticallyScrolled = panels.some(p => p.scrollTop > 4);
    document.body.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', horizontallyOffStart || anyVerticallyScrolled);
  }
  content.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrolled, { passive: true });
  panels.forEach(p => p.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrolled, { passive: true }));

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;
    const activeIdx = order.findIndex(id => sidebarItems.find(s => s.dataset.target === id && s.classList.contains('active')));
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && activeIdx < order.length - 1) {
      scrollToTarget(order[activeIdx + 1]); setActive(order[activeIdx + 1]);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && activeIdx > 0) {
      scrollToTarget(order[activeIdx - 1]); setActive(order[activeIdx - 1]);
    }
  });

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    scrollToTarget('about');
    setActive('about');
  });

  /* ===== Active panel + parallax on horizontal scroll ===== */
  function getSnapOffsetPx() {
    const v = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
      .getPropertyValue('--snap-offset')
      .trim();
    // calc() values aren't resolved by getComputedStyle on :root vars in
    // every engine, so fall back to a measured value from the spacer.
    const parsed = parseFloat(v);
    if (!isNaN(parsed) && v.endsWith('px')) return parsed;
    const spacer = document.querySelector('.content-spacer');
    return spacer ? spacer.offsetWidth : 0;
  }

  let snapOffsetCached = getSnapOffsetPx();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    snapOffsetCached = getSnapOffsetPx();
    requestAnimationFrame(applyParallax);
  });

  function syncActivePanelClass() {
    const cw = content.clientWidth;
    const sl = content.scrollLeft;
    let bestIdx = 0;
    let bestOverlap = -1;
    panels.forEach((p, i) => {
      const pl = p.offsetLeft;
      const pr = pl + p.offsetWidth;
      const overlap = Math.max(0, Math.min(pr, sl + cw) - Math.max(pl, sl));
      if (overlap > bestOverlap) {
        bestOverlap = overlap;
        bestIdx = i;
      }
    });
    panels.forEach((p, i) => p.classList.toggle('active', i === bestIdx));
  }

  // Parallax: outgoing panel lags behind (deceleration / repulsion feel),
  // incoming panel slides in slightly delayed too. Multiple layers move at
  // different rates so it feels like depth instead of one rigid block.
  function applyParallax() {
    const sl = content.scrollLeft;
    panels.forEach(panel => {
      if (!panel.offsetWidth) return; // hidden
      const inner = panel.querySelector('.panel-inner');
      if (!inner) return;

      const pl = panel.offsetLeft;
      const pw = panel.offsetWidth;
      const visibleLeft = pl - sl;
      const offset = visibleLeft - snapOffsetCached; // 0 when current

      // Normalised distance (-1 .. 1 across one panel width either side)
      const t = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, offset / pw));
      // ease-out cubic so deceleration is gentle as a panel approaches
      // its snap position from either direction
      const eased = t < 0
        ? -(1 - Math.pow(1 + t, 3))
        :  (1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3));
      // Inner lag — outgoing translates right (positive), upcoming left
      const innerLag = -eased * 70;
      inner.style.transform = `translate3d(${innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;

      // Differential parallax on the artwork (moves slightly faster than
      // surrounding text — creates a subtle depth effect)
      const artwork = panel.querySelector('.artwork');
      if (artwork) {
        const artLag = -eased * 110;
        artwork.style.transform = `translate3d(${artLag - innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;
      }
      // Title nudges in the opposite direction for visual punch
      const title = panel.querySelector('h1.title, h1.page-title, .welcome h1');
      if (title) {
        const titleLag = -eased * 40;
        title.style.transform = `translate3d(${titleLag - innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;
      }
    });
  }

  function scheduleScrollUpdate() {
    if (parallaxRAF) return;

      applyParallax();
      parallaxRAF = null;

    applyParallax();

    const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' });

    // Per-panel vertical reveal
    panels.forEach(panel => {
      const items = panel.querySelectorAll('.sec, .focus-card, .skill, .process-step, .image-placeholder, .image-row, .outcome-card, .impact-bar, .mini-process .step, .contact-form, .calendly-card');

        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
            panelIO.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { root: panel, threshold: 0.18 });
      items.forEach(el => { el.classList.add('reveal'); panelIO.observe(el); });
    });

  function hideLoader() {
    const loader = document.getElementById('loader');
    if (!loader) return;
    loader.classList.add('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => { loader.style.display = 'none'; }, 700);

    setTimeout(hideLoader, 900);
  });

  if (document.readyState === 'complete') setTimeout(hideLoader, 900);

  /* ===== iPadOS-style custom cursor ===== */
  (function initCursor() {
    if (window.matchMedia('(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)').matches) return;
    const shape = document.getElementById('cursorShape');
    const dot = document.getElementById('cursorDot');
    if (!shape || !dot) return;

    let mouseX = window.innerWidth / 2;
    let mouseY = window.innerHeight / 2;
    let shapeX = mouseX, shapeY = mouseY;
    let targetW = 28, targetH = 28, targetR = 50;
    let curW = 28, curH = 28, curR = 50;
    let hoverEl = null;
    let lockToEl = false;

    // Only truly clickable / focusable elements morph the cursor
    const interactiveSel = [
      'a[href]',
      'button',
      'input:not([type="hidden"])',
      'textarea',
      'select',
      '.sidebar-item',
      '.focus-card',
      '.link-pill',
      '.social-btn',
      '.nav-side',
      '.cal-btn',
      '.project-card',
      '.bn-tab',
      '[data-target]:not(.process-step)',
      '[data-scroll-to]',
      '[role="button"]'
    ].join(', ');

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      mouseX = e.clientX;
      mouseY = e.clientY;
      dot.style.left = mouseX + 'px';
      dot.style.top = mouseY + 'px';

      const target = e.target.closest(interactiveSel);
      if (target && target !== hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = target;
        const r = target.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Hug the element fully — no caps. Add a small padding so the cursor
        // sits a couple of pixels outside the element's edges.
        targetW = r.width + 8;
        targetH = r.height + 8;
        // Match element's border-radius where possible
        const cs = getComputedStyle(target);
        let br = parseFloat(cs.borderRadius);
        if (isNaN(br) || br === 0) br = 12;
        const cap = Math.min(targetW, targetH) / 2;
        if (br > cap) br = cap;
        targetR = br;
        shape.classList.add('on-element');
        lockToEl = true;
        // Snap shape to element center for smooth morph
        shapeX = r.left + r.width / 2;
        shapeY = r.top + r.height / 2;
      } else if (!target && hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = null;
        targetW = 22;
        targetH = 22;
        targetR = 50;
        shape.classList.remove('on-element');
        lockToEl = false;
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      document.body.classList.add('cursor-hidden');
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('cursor-hidden');
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
      shape.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.92)';
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      shape.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
    });

    function tick() {
      // Smoothly approach target dimensions
      curW += (targetW - curW) * 0.22;
      curH += (targetH - curH) * 0.22;
      curR += (targetR - curR) * 0.22;

      if (lockToEl && hoverEl && document.contains(hoverEl)) {
        const r = hoverEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Slight magnetic offset toward mouse position within element
        const cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
        const cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
        const offX = (mouseX - cx) * 0.18;
        const offY = (mouseY - cy) * 0.18;
        shapeX += ((cx + offX) - shapeX) * 0.35;
        shapeY += ((cy + offY) - shapeY) * 0.35;
      } else {
        shapeX += (mouseX - shapeX) * 0.22;
        shapeY += (mouseY - shapeY) * 0.22;
      }

      shape.style.width = curW + 'px';
      shape.style.height = curH + 'px';
      // Use percentage of smaller side to keep border-radius proportional
      if (targetR >= 50 - 0.5) {
        shape.style.borderRadius = '50%';
      } else {
        shape.style.borderRadius = curR + 'px';
      }
      shape.style.left = shapeX + 'px';
      shape.style.top = shapeY + 'px';

      // Dot fades slightly when on a button-like element for cleaner look
      dot.classList.toggle('faded', lockToEl);

      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    tick();
  })();
</script>
</body>

    .sidebar,

  /* Content area — no card, full-bleed */
  .content {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    display: flex;

    z-index: 1;
    scroll-padding-left: var(--snap-offset);

  /* Spacer pushes the first panel to start at the snap position */
  .content-spacer {
    flex: 0 0 var(--snap-offset);
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .panel {
    flex: 0 0 calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    height: 100vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    scroll-snap-stop: always;
    /* padding-left = bleed + 56 (= navbar-overlap + breathing). With
       padding-right = 56 and panel-inner auto-margins, the inner column
       auto-centers exactly within the visible area (right of navbar). */
    padding: 72px var(--pad-right) 80px var(--pad-left);
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;

  .panel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  .panel-inner {
    max-width: var(--inner-max);
    margin: 0 auto;          /* auto-centers in panel content area */
    will-change: transform;

  /* Sections that bleed across the panel (artwork). The element spans
     panel.left → panel.right, so when the panel is scrolled out the
     gradient fills the navbar area continuously. Inner padding pushes
     the label so it still lines up with the centered title above. */
  .bleed-left {
    /* CSS magic: 50% - 50vw + snap-offset/2 gives the negative-margin
       needed to reach panel.left from any auto-centered child, because
       50% (of parent) sits at the visible-area center. */
    margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    max-width: none;
    padding-left: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    padding-right: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    box-sizing: border-box;

          </div>

          <h2 class="section-title">Validation</h2>
          <p class="body" style="color:var(--text-tertiary);font-style:italic;">[Add: usability tests, A/B results, analytics deltas, qualitative feedback. Reference what you learned and how the design evolved.]</p>

          ${imagePlaceholder("Before / after", "[Side-by-side comparison or testing artifacts that show the impact of changes.]", "wide")}

          <h2 class="section-title">Impact</h2>
          <div class="impact-chart">
            <div class="ic-title">Before → After</div>
            <div class="impact-bar">
              <div class="lbl">Task completion</div>
              <div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width: 78%; --c1:${p.colors[0]}; --c2:${p.colors[1]};"></div></div>
              <div class="val">[+XX%]</div>
            </div>
            <div class="impact-bar">
              <div class="lbl">Time on task</div>
              <div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width: 62%; --c1:${p.colors[0]}; --c2:${p.colors[1]};"></div></div>
              <div class="val">[-XX%]</div>
            </div>
            <div class="impact-bar">
              <div class="lbl">Satisfaction (CSAT)</div>
              <div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width: 86%; --c1:${p.colors[0]}; --c2:${p.colors[1]};"></div></div>
              <div class="val">[+XX pts]</div>
            </div>
            <div class="impact-bar">
              <div class="lbl">Support tickets</div>
              <div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width: 45%; --c1:${p.colors[0]}; --c2:${p.colors[1]};"></div></div>
              <div class="val">[-XX%]</div>
            </div>

          <div class="outcome-grid">
            <div class="outcome-card"><div class="n">[XX%]</div><div class="l">Primary success metric</div></div>
            <div class="outcome-card"><div class="n">[XX%]</div><div class="l">Secondary lift</div></div>
            <div class="outcome-card"><div class="n">[Qual]</div><div class="l">User or team feedback</div></div>
          </div>
          <p class="body">${escapeHtml(p.results)}</p>

          ${p.url && p.url !== "#" ? `<a class="link-pill" href="${escapeHtml(p.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View ${escapeHtml(p.title)} →</a>` : ""}

          <h2 class="section-title">Reflections</h2>
          <p class="body" style="color:var(--text-tertiary);font-style:italic;">[Add: what you'd do differently, what surprised you, what you took into the next project. Honest, brief, specific.]</p>

  // Render project panels
  const content = document.getElementById('content');
  const template = document.getElementById('projectTemplate');
  projects.forEach((p, i) => {
    const prevId = i === 0 ? "projects-list" : projects[i - 1].id;
    const nextId = i < projects.length - 1 ? projects[i + 1].id : null;
    template.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', renderProjectPanel(p, prevId, nextId));

  // Render projects-list cards
  const projectsListGrid = document.getElementById('projectsListGrid');
  if (projectsListGrid) {
    projectsListGrid.innerHTML = projects.map(p => `
      <button class="pl-card" data-target="${p.id}">
        <div class="pl-thumb" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg, ${p.colors[0]}, ${p.colors[1]});">
          <span>${escapeHtml(p.title)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pl-title">${escapeHtml(p.title)}</div>
        <div class="pl-tag">${escapeHtml(p.tagline)}</div>
        <div class="pl-arrow">Open case study →</div>
      </button>
    `).join('');
  }

  const panels = Array.from(content.querySelectorAll('.panel'));
  const sidebarItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-item[data-target]'));

  function scrollToTarget(id) {
    let panel = panels.find(p => p.dataset.id === id);
    if (!panel) return;
    // If panel is hidden at this breakpoint (e.g., projects-list on desktop),
    // fall back to the nearest visible neighbour so navigation never dead-ends.
    if (panel.offsetWidth === 0) {
      const idx = order.indexOf(id);
      let fallback = null;
      for (let i = idx - 1; i >= 0 && !fallback; i--) {
        const c = panels.find(p => p.dataset.id === order[i]);
        if (c && c.offsetWidth > 0) fallback = c;
      }
      if (!fallback) for (let i = idx + 1; i < order.length && !fallback; i++) {
        const c = panels.find(p => p.dataset.id === order[i]);
        if (c && c.offsetWidth > 0) fallback = c;
      }
      if (!fallback) return;
      panel = fallback;
    }
    content.scrollTo({ left: panel.offsetLeft, behavior: 'smooth' });
    panel.scrollTop = 0;
  }

  function setActive(id) {
    sidebarItems.forEach(item => {
      item.classList.toggle('active', item.dataset.target === id);
    });
    // Sync mobile bottom-nav: "About" stays active on the about panel,
    // "Projects" stays active on the list and on any individual project.
    const bnTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.bn-tab');
    bnTabs.forEach(tab => {
      const tabTarget = tab.dataset.bnTarget;
      const isAboutTab = tabTarget === 'about';
      const isProjectsTab = tabTarget === 'projects-list';
      const matches = isAboutTab
        ? id === 'about'
        : (id === 'projects-list' || projects.some(p => p.id === id));
      tab.classList.toggle('active', matches);
    });
  }

  sidebarItems.forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const id = item.dataset.target;
      scrollToTarget(id);
      setActive(id);
    });
  });

  // Bottom-nav (mobile) tabs
  document.querySelectorAll('.bn-tab').forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const id = tab.dataset.bnTarget;
      scrollToTarget(id);
      setActive(id);
    });
  });

  content.addEventListener('click', e => {
    // In-panel anchor: scroll within current panel to an element with a given id
    const scrollTrigger = e.target.closest('[data-scroll-to]');
    if (scrollTrigger) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const targetEl = document.getElementById(scrollTrigger.dataset.scrollTo);
      if (targetEl) {
        const panel = targetEl.closest('.panel');
        if (panel) {
          panel.scrollTo({ top: targetEl.offsetTop - 32, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    const trigger = e.target.closest('[data-target]');
    if (!trigger) return;
    if (trigger.classList.contains('sidebar-item')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const id = trigger.dataset.target;
    scrollToTarget(id);
    setActive(id);
  });

  // Contact form: hand off to user's mail client + show inline confirmation
  window.handleContactSubmit = function(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.target;
    const name = encodeURIComponent(form.name.value || '');
    const email = encodeURIComponent(form.email.value || '');
    const subject = encodeURIComponent(form.subject.value || 'Hello from your portfolio');
    const message = encodeURIComponent(
      (form.message.value || '') +
      '\n\n— ' + (form.name.value || '') +
      '\n' + (form.email.value || '')
    );
    const mailto = `mailto:filipe.eck@gmail.com?subject=${subject}&body=${message}`;
    window.location.href = mailto;
    document.getElementById('formSuccess').classList.add('show');
    return false;
  };

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0.5) {
        setActive(entry.target.dataset.id);
      }
    });
  }, {
    root: content,
    threshold: [0.5, 0.75]
  });
  panels.forEach(p => observer.observe(p));

  function updateScrolled() {
    const horizontallyOffStart = content.scrollLeft > 4;
    const anyVerticallyScrolled = panels.some(p => p.scrollTop > 4);
    document.body.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', horizontallyOffStart || anyVerticallyScrolled);
  }
  content.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrolled, { passive: true });
  panels.forEach(p => p.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrolled, { passive: true }));

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;
    const activeIdx = order.findIndex(id => sidebarItems.find(s => s.dataset.target === id && s.classList.contains('active')));
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && activeIdx < order.length - 1) {
      scrollToTarget(order[activeIdx + 1]); setActive(order[activeIdx + 1]);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && activeIdx > 0) {
      scrollToTarget(order[activeIdx - 1]); setActive(order[activeIdx - 1]);
    }
  });

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    scrollToTarget('about');
    setActive('about');
  });

  /* ===== Active panel + parallax on horizontal scroll ===== */
  function getSnapOffsetPx() {
    const v = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
      .getPropertyValue('--snap-offset')
      .trim();
    // calc() values aren't resolved by getComputedStyle on :root vars in
    // every engine, so fall back to a measured value from the spacer.
    const parsed = parseFloat(v);
    if (!isNaN(parsed) && v.endsWith('px')) return parsed;
    const spacer = document.querySelector('.content-spacer');
    return spacer ? spacer.offsetWidth : 0;
  }

  let snapOffsetCached = getSnapOffsetPx();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    snapOffsetCached = getSnapOffsetPx();
    requestAnimationFrame(applyParallax);
  });

  function syncActivePanelClass() {
    const cw = content.clientWidth;
    const sl = content.scrollLeft;
    let bestIdx = 0;
    let bestOverlap = -1;
    panels.forEach((p, i) => {
      const pl = p.offsetLeft;
      const pr = pl + p.offsetWidth;
      const overlap = Math.max(0, Math.min(pr, sl + cw) - Math.max(pl, sl));
      if (overlap > bestOverlap) {
        bestOverlap = overlap;
        bestIdx = i;
      }
    });
    panels.forEach((p, i) => p.classList.toggle('active', i === bestIdx));
  }

  // Parallax: outgoing panel lags behind (deceleration / repulsion feel),
  // incoming panel slides in slightly delayed too. Multiple layers move at
  // different rates so it feels like depth instead of one rigid block.
  function applyParallax() {
    const sl = content.scrollLeft;
    panels.forEach(panel => {
      if (!panel.offsetWidth) return; // hidden
      const inner = panel.querySelector('.panel-inner');
      if (!inner) return;

      const pl = panel.offsetLeft;
      const pw = panel.offsetWidth;
      const visibleLeft = pl - sl;
      const offset = visibleLeft - snapOffsetCached; // 0 when current

      // Normalised distance (-1 .. 1 across one panel width either side)
      const t = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, offset / pw));
      // ease-out cubic so deceleration is gentle as a panel approaches
      // its snap position from either direction
      const eased = t < 0
        ? -(1 - Math.pow(1 + t, 3))
        :  (1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3));
      // Inner lag — outgoing translates right (positive), upcoming left
      const innerLag = -eased * 70;
      inner.style.transform = `translate3d(${innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;

      // Differential parallax on the artwork (moves slightly faster than
      // surrounding text — creates a subtle depth effect)
      const artwork = panel.querySelector('.artwork');
      if (artwork) {
        const artLag = -eased * 110;
        artwork.style.transform = `translate3d(${artLag - innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;
      }
      // Title nudges in the opposite direction for visual punch
      const title = panel.querySelector('h1.title, h1.page-title, .welcome h1');
      if (title) {
        const titleLag = -eased * 40;
        title.style.transform = `translate3d(${titleLag - innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;
      }
    });
  }

  let parallaxRAF = null;
  function scheduleScrollUpdate() {
    if (parallaxRAF) return;
    parallaxRAF = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      syncActivePanelClass();
      applyParallax();
      parallaxRAF = null;
    });
  }
  content.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleScrollUpdate, { passive: true });
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    syncActivePanelClass();
    applyParallax();
  });

  /* ===== Scroll reveal observer ===== */
  function setupReveal() {
    const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' });
    revealEls.forEach(el => io.observe(el));

    // Per-panel vertical reveal
    panels.forEach(panel => {
      const items = panel.querySelectorAll('.sec, .focus-card, .skill, .process-step, .image-placeholder, .image-row, .outcome-card, .impact-bar, .mini-process .step, .contact-form, .calendly-card');
      const panelIO = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
            panelIO.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { root: panel, threshold: 0.18 });
      items.forEach(el => { el.classList.add('reveal'); panelIO.observe(el); });
    });
  }
  setupReveal();

  /* ===== Initial loader ===== */
  function hideLoader() {
    const loader = document.getElementById('loader');
    if (!loader) return;
    loader.classList.add('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => { loader.style.display = 'none'; }, 700);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    setTimeout(hideLoader, 900);
  });
  // Fallback in case 'load' already fired
  if (document.readyState === 'complete') setTimeout(hideLoader, 900);

  /* ===== iPadOS-style custom cursor ===== */
  (function initCursor() {
    if (window.matchMedia('(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)').matches) return;
    const shape = document.getElementById('cursorShape');
    const dot = document.getElementById('cursorDot');
    if (!shape || !dot) return;

    let mouseX = window.innerWidth / 2;
    let mouseY = window.innerHeight / 2;
    let shapeX = mouseX, shapeY = mouseY;
    let targetW = 28, targetH = 28, targetR = 50;
    let curW = 28, curH = 28, curR = 50;
    let hoverEl = null;
    let lockToEl = false;

    // Only truly clickable / focusable elements morph the cursor
    const interactiveSel = [
      'a[href]',
      'button',
      'input:not([type="hidden"])',
      'textarea',
      'select',
      '.sidebar-item',
      '.focus-card',
      '.link-pill',
      '.social-btn',
      '.nav-side',
      '.cal-btn',
      '.project-card',
      '.bn-tab',
      '[data-target]:not(.process-step)',
      '[data-scroll-to]',
      '[role="button"]'
    ].join(', ');

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      mouseX = e.clientX;
      mouseY = e.clientY;
      dot.style.left = mouseX + 'px';
      dot.style.top = mouseY + 'px';

      const target = e.target.closest(interactiveSel);
      if (target && target !== hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = target;
        const r = target.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Hug the element fully — no caps. Add a small padding so the cursor
        // sits a couple of pixels outside the element's edges.
        targetW = r.width + 8;
        targetH = r.height + 8;
        // Match element's border-radius where possible
        const cs = getComputedStyle(target);
        let br = parseFloat(cs.borderRadius);
        if (isNaN(br) || br === 0) br = 12;
        const cap = Math.min(targetW, targetH) / 2;
        if (br > cap) br = cap;
        targetR = br;
        shape.classList.add('on-element');
        lockToEl = true;
        // Snap shape to element center for smooth morph
        shapeX = r.left + r.width / 2;
        shapeY = r.top + r.height / 2;
      } else if (!target && hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = null;
        targetW = 22;
        targetH = 22;
        targetR = 50;
        shape.classList.remove('on-element');
        lockToEl = false;
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      document.body.classList.add('cursor-hidden');
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('cursor-hidden');
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
      shape.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.92)';
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      shape.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
    });

    function tick() {
      // Smoothly approach target dimensions
      curW += (targetW - curW) * 0.22;
      curH += (targetH - curH) * 0.22;
      curR += (targetR - curR) * 0.22;

      if (lockToEl && hoverEl && document.contains(hoverEl)) {
        const r = hoverEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Slight magnetic offset toward mouse position within element
        const cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
        const cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
        const offX = (mouseX - cx) * 0.18;
        const offY = (mouseY - cy) * 0.18;
        shapeX += ((cx + offX) - shapeX) * 0.35;
        shapeY += ((cy + offY) - shapeY) * 0.35;
      } else {
        shapeX += (mouseX - shapeX) * 0.22;
        shapeY += (mouseY - shapeY) * 0.22;
      }

      shape.style.width = curW + 'px';
      shape.style.height = curH + 'px';
      // Use percentage of smaller side to keep border-radius proportional
      if (targetR >= 50 - 0.5) {
        shape.style.borderRadius = '50%';
      } else {
        shape.style.borderRadius = curR + 'px';
      }
      shape.style.left = shapeX + 'px';
      shape.style.top = shapeY + 'px';

      // Dot fades slightly when on a button-like element for cleaner look
      dot.classList.toggle('faded', lockToEl);

      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    tick();
  })();
</script>
</body>

<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #f4f4f6;
    --sidebar-bg: rgba(245, 245, 247, 0.72);
    --sidebar-bg-scrolled: rgba(235, 235, 240, 0.55);
    --text-primary: #1d1d1f;

    --radius: 24px;

    /* Right edge of the navbar in viewport coords */
    --navbar-right: calc(var(--sidebar-gap) + var(--sidebar-width));
    /* How many pixels of each panel sit behind the navbar */
    --bleed: 84px;
    /* Where each panel's left edge snaps in the viewport.
       navbar.right - bleed → panels extend exactly --bleed behind the navbar. */
    --snap-offset: calc(var(--navbar-right) - var(--bleed));
    /* Panel content inner-width target */
    --inner-max: 820px;
    /* Horizontal padding on each side. padding-left = bleed + 56 so the

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(255, 126, 135, 0.32); }
    50% { transform: scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(255, 126, 135, 0.42); }

  .loader-bar {
    width: 140px;
    height: 3px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
    border-radius: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;

    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent), transparent);
    transform: translateX(-100%);

    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;

  /* ===== Custom cursor (iPadOS-style) ===== */
  .cursor-shape {
    position: fixed;
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: width 0.24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),
                height 0.24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),
                border-radius 0.24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),
                background 0.22s ease,
                opacity 0.18s ease;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9998;
    mix-blend-mode: multiply;
  }
  .cursor-shape.on-element {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  }
  .cursor-dot {
    position: fixed;
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.05s linear;
  }
  .cursor-dot.faded { opacity: 0.55; }
  body.cursor-hidden .cursor-shape,
  body.cursor-hidden .cursor-dot { opacity: 0; }
  /* Hide native cursor */
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    body:not(.no-custom-cursor),
    body:not(.no-custom-cursor) * {
      cursor: none !important;
    }
    body.no-custom-cursor .cursor-shape,
    body.no-custom-cursor .cursor-dot { display: none; }
  }
  @media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse) {
    .cursor-shape, .cursor-dot { display: none; }
  }

  /* ===== Scroll reveal animations ===== */
  .reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px);
    transition: opacity 0.7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);

  .reveal.in-view {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);

  .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: 0.06s; }
  .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: 0.12s; }
  .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: 0.18s; }
  .reveal-delay-4 { transition-delay: 0.24s; }

     Transform is driven by JS parallax — only opacity transitions here. */
  .panel:not(.active) .panel-inner { opacity: 0.5; }

    transition-delay: 0.04s;
    opacity: 1;

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .reveal, .reveal.in-view { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; transition: none !important; }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {

    .impact-bar {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;

      gap: 6px 12px;

    .impact-bar .lbl { grid-area: lbl; }
    .impact-bar .val { grid-area: val; }
    .impact-bar .track { grid-area: trk; height: 8px; }
    .impact-chart { padding: 14px; }

    /* Projects list — single column with bigger cards */
    .projects-list-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 18px;
    }
    .pl-card { padding: 16px; }
    .pl-card .pl-thumb { aspect-ratio: 16 / 8; font-size: 16px; }
    .pl-card .pl-title { font-size: 16px; }
    .pl-card .pl-tag { font-size: 13px; }

    /* Hero artwork — taller on mobile for more visual presence */
    .artwork {

    /* Bleed-left fallback (still used elsewhere if class was applied) */
    .bleed-left { margin-left: 0; margin-right: 0; width: 100%; padding-left: 0; padding-right: 0; }

    /* Image placeholders sized down */
    .image-placeholder { padding: 18px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; margin: 12px 0; }
    .image-placeholder.wide { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }
    .image-placeholder.tall { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }

    .process-flow { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 18px; }

  @media (max-width: 480px) {

  /* Content area — no card, full-bleed */
  .content {
    position: fixed;

    overflow-y: hidden;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    display: flex;

  /* Spacer pushes the first panel to start at the snap position */
  .content-spacer {
    flex: 0 0 var(--snap-offset);
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .panel {
    flex: 0 0 calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    height: 100vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    scroll-snap-stop: always;
    /* padding-left = bleed + 56 (= navbar-overlap + breathing). With
       padding-right = 56 and panel-inner auto-margins, the inner column
       auto-centers exactly within the visible area (right of navbar). */
    padding: 72px var(--pad-right) 80px var(--pad-left);

  .panel-inner {
    max-width: var(--inner-max);
    margin: 0 auto;          /* auto-centers in panel content area */
    will-change: transform;

     panel.left → panel.right, so when the panel is scrolled out the
     gradient fills the navbar area continuously. Inner padding pushes
     the label so it still lines up with the centered title above. */
  .bleed-left {
    /* CSS magic: 50% - 50vw + snap-offset/2 gives the negative-margin
       needed to reach panel.left from any auto-centered child, because
       50% (of parent) sits at the visible-area center. */
    margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw + var(--snap-offset) / 2);
    width: calc(100vw - var(--snap-offset));
    max-width: none;
    padding-left: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    padding-right: calc(50vw - var(--snap-offset) / 2 - 50%);
    box-sizing: border-box;

  /* Project hero/artwork */
  .artwork {
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;

  .image-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 14px;
    margin: 14px 0;

  .image-row .image-placeholder { margin: 0; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }

    font-weight: 500;

  .outcome-card .n {

  .contact-block {

  .contact-block h3 {

    margin-bottom: 14px;

  /* ===== About page: welcome hero (above the fold) ===== */
  .welcome {
    min-height: calc(100vh - 152px);

    flex-direction: column;

    gap: 24px;
    padding-bottom: 24px;

      #ff7e87, #ffb88c, #b48aff, #5e8df4, #34d399, #b48aff, #ff7e87);
