  /* ===== Contact form ===== */
  .contact-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-top: 14px;
  }
  .contact-form {
    background: white;
    border: 1px solid var(--divider);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 22px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .contact-form h3 {
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }
  .contact-form .row { display: flex; gap: 12px; }
  .contact-form .row > * { flex: 1; }
  .contact-form label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
  }
  .contact-form input,
  .contact-form textarea {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--divider);
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    background: #fafafb;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    resize: vertical;
  }
  .contact-form input:focus,
  .contact-form textarea:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--accent);
    background: white;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.12);
  }
  .contact-form textarea {
    min-height: 96px;
    max-height: 240px;
  }
  .contact-form button[type="submit"] {
    align-self: flex-start;
  }
  .form-success {
    background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.12);
    color: #047857;
    border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.3);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    font-size: 13px;
    display: none;
  }
  .form-success.show { display: block; }

  .calendly-card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #007aff, #5e3aff);
    color: white;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 22px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.2);
  }
  .calendly-card h3 {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .calendly-card p {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
  }
  .calendly-card .cal-illustration {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 14px;
    margin: 6px 0;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  .calendly-card .cal-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
    padding: 6px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  }
  .calendly-card .cal-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .calendly-card .cal-row .time {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .calendly-card .cal-btn {
    background: white;
    color: #1e3a8a;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 13px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    align-self: flex-start;
    transition: transform 0.15s;
  }
  .calendly-card .cal-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

  .contact-meta {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-top: 18px;
    padding-top: 18px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--divider);
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .contact-meta a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; }

  /* ===== Project page: process timeline + impact chart ===== */
  .mini-process {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 10px;
    margin: 18px 0 28px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.025);
    padding: 16px;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }
  .mini-process .step {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .mini-process .step .ph {
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .mini-process .step .nm {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .mini-process .step .ds {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .mini-process .step .bar {
    height: 3px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: var(--accent);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    opacity: 0.85;
  }
  .mini-process .step:nth-child(1) .bar { opacity: 0.4; }
  .mini-process .step:nth-child(2) .bar { opacity: 0.6; }
  .mini-process .step:nth-child(3) .bar { opacity: 0.8; }
  .mini-process .step:nth-child(4) .bar { opacity: 1; }

  .impact-chart {
    margin: 8px 0 24px;
    padding: 18px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--divider);
  }
  .impact-chart .ic-title {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .impact-bar {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 130px 1fr 70px;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .impact-bar:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .impact-bar .lbl { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-primary); }
  .impact-bar .track {
    height: 10px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
    border-radius: 5px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
  }
  .impact-bar .fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--c1, #007aff), var(--c2, #5e3aff));
    border-radius: 5px;
    transition: width 0.6s ease;
  }
  .impact-bar .val {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    text-align: right;
  }

  /* Mobile-only back button injected in project panels — hidden on desktop */
  .mobile-back-btn { display: none; }

  /* Mobile-only scroll edge effect — hidden on desktop */
  .scroll-edge { display: none; }

  /* Panel nav hint */
  .panel-nav-hint {
    margin-top: 48px;
    padding: 20px 0 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--divider);
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 16px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .panel-nav-hint .nav-side {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.15s;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    font-family: inherit;
    padding: 0;
  }
  .panel-nav-hint .nav-side:hover { color: var(--accent); }
  .panel-nav-hint .nav-side .name {
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  .panel-nav-hint .nav-side .label {
    font-size: 11px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
  .panel-nav-hint .nav-side.nav-right { text-align: right; }

  /* =========================================================
     MOBILE OVERRIDES — kept at the end of the stylesheet so
     these win over equal-specificity desktop rules at <=768px.
     ========================================================= */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    :root {
      --sidebar-width: 0px;
      --sidebar-gap: 0px;
      --bleed: 0px;
      --content-offset: 0px;
      --snap-offset: 0px;
      --pad-left: 20px;
      --pad-right: 20px;
    }

    /* Fully hide the desktop sidebar */
    .sidebar,
    aside.sidebar { display: none !important; }

    /* === Disable horizontal swipe between About and Projects ===
       Both panels become positioned overlays, swapped by class. */
    .content {
      overflow: hidden;
      display: block;
      scroll-snap-type: none;
    }
    .content-spacer { display: none; }

    .panel {
      width: 100vw;
      flex: none;
      height: 100dvh;
      padding: 24px 20px 96px 20px;
    }
    .panel[data-id="about"],
    .panel[data-id="projects-list"] {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100dvh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      z-index: 5;
      transform: translateX(0);
      transition: transform 0.34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
                  filter 0.34s ease;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      touch-action: pan-y;
    }
    .panel[data-id="projects-list"] { transform: translateX(100%); }
    body.show-projects .panel[data-id="about"] {
      /* About is completely off-screen when Projects tab is active —
         not a layer below, a real separate page. */
      transform: translateX(-100%);
    }
    body.show-projects .panel[data-id="projects-list"] { transform: translateX(0); }

    /* While a project is open, the projects-list slides slightly left
       behind it (iOS push parallax) and dims. */
    body.project-open .panel[data-id="projects-list"] {
      transform: translateX(-22%);
      filter: brightness(0.92);
    }
    /* Also keep About fully out of the way during project view */
    body.project-open .panel[data-id="about"] {
      transform: translateX(-100%);
    }

    .panel-inner { max-width: 100%; }
    .panel:not(.active) .panel-inner { opacity: 1; }

    /* === Project panels — slide-in pages (iOS-style push) === */
    .panel.is-project {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100dvh;
      flex: none;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
      z-index: 40;
      background: var(--bg);
      overflow-y: auto;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      padding: 0 0 60px 0; /* sticky header sits at the very top */
      /* No box-shadow here: with 9 project panels stacked at translateX(100%)
         the shadows would bleed into the visible viewport as a grey gradient
         on the right edge. We use a pseudo-element only on the OPEN panel. */
      touch-action: pan-y;
    }
    .panel.is-project::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: -1px;
      width: 1px;
      box-shadow: -10px 0 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .panel.is-project.is-open { transform: translateX(0); }
    .panel.is-project.is-open::before { opacity: 1; }
    .panel.is-project.is-dragging { transition: none; }
    .panel.is-project .panel-inner {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      padding: 8px 20px 24px;
      max-width: 100%;
    }

    /* === Liquid Glass back button — floats as a toolbar pill ===
       Per Apple's "Menus and toolbars" guidance, toolbar items adopt the
       Liquid Glass material and float above content. Implemented as a
       sticky pill at the top-left, not a full-width bar. */
    .mobile-back-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      position: sticky;
      top: max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-top));
      margin: max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) 0 6px 14px;
      padding: 8px 14px 8px 8px;
      z-index: 10;
      /* Glass material — matches the bottom nav */
      background: rgba(248, 248, 250, 0.45);
      backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(28px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(28px);
      border: 0.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      border-radius: 999px;
      box-shadow:
        0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10),
        0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6),
        inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      color: var(--accent);
      cursor: pointer;
      align-self: flex-start;
      width: auto;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
    }
    .mobile-back-btn::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.40) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 28%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 55%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .mobile-back-btn:active {
      transform: scale(0.96);
      background: rgba(248, 248, 250, 0.6);
    }
    .mobile-back-btn svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      stroke-width: 2.4;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .mobile-back-btn > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    /* Hide bottom-nav while a project is open */
    body.project-open .bottom-nav {
      transform: translateY(160%);
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .bottom-nav { transition: transform 0.25s ease, opacity 0.25s ease; }

    /* ============================================================
       iOS 26 Liquid Glass bottom nav
       Adopts Apple's Liquid Glass navigation principles:
       - Floats as a distinct topmost layer above the content
       - Scroll edge effect obscures content behind for legibility
       - Minimize-on-scroll-down, expand-on-scroll-up
       - Dynamic material with strong saturation and blur
       ============================================================ */

    /* Scroll edge effect — a soft gradient just above the nav that
       fades scrolling content for legibility under the glass. */
    .scroll-edge {
      display: block;
      position: fixed;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      height: 130px;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 49;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg,
        rgba(244, 244, 246, 0) 0%,
        rgba(244, 244, 246, 0.55) 55%,
        rgba(244, 244, 246, 0.92) 100%);
      opacity: 1;
      transition: opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
    }
    body.project-open .scroll-edge { opacity: 0; }
    body.nav-minimized .scroll-edge {
      transform: translateY(100%);
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .bottom-nav {
      display: flex;
      position: fixed;
      left: 14px;
      right: 14px;
      bottom: max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      height: 64px;
      padding: 6px;
      border-radius: 999px; /* full capsule */
      /* Glass material — lighter, lets more content show through */
      background: rgba(248, 248, 250, 0.32);
      backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(28px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(28px);
      border: 0.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      box-shadow:
        0 18px 52px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12),
        0 2px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6),
        inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
      gap: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      will-change: transform, opacity;
      /* Adopt the system minimize transition curve */
      transition:
        transform 0.34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
        opacity 0.28s ease,
        height 0.34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
        padding 0.34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
    }
    /* Specular highlight on top edge — the "wet" glass look */
    .bottom-nav::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45) 0%,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 22%,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 50%,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    /* Faint refraction gradient at the bottom */
    .bottom-nav::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: radial-gradient(120% 100% at 50% 100%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 60%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 2;
      mix-blend-mode: overlay;
    }

    /* Minimized state — nav recedes when user scrolls down */
    body.nav-minimized .bottom-nav {
      transform: translateY(calc(100% + max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) + 8px));
      opacity: 0;
    }

    /* Sliding pill indicator that morphs to the active tab.
       Sits right up against the nav's border (only 2px gap). */
    .bn-indicator {
      position: absolute;
      top: 2px;
      bottom: 2px;
      left: 0;
      width: 0;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border-radius: 999px;
      /* No outer drop shadow — flatter, cleaner. Just a subtle inner highlight
         to retain a hint of glassy depth. */
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
      transform: translateX(0);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 1;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .bn-indicator.is-ready {
      opacity: 1;
      /* iOS 26 fluid morph curve */
      transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
                  width 0.45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
                  opacity 0.2s ease;
    }

    .bn-tab {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 3;
      background: transparent !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
      padding: 0;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.25s ease;
    }
    .bn-tab svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; transition: stroke 0.25s; }
    .bn-tab.active {
      color: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .bn-tab.active svg { color: var(--accent); }

    /* === Typography === */
    h1.title {
      font-size: 32px;
      line-height: 1.12;
      letter-spacing: -0.022em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      word-wrap: break-word;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
      hyphens: auto;
    }
    h2.section-title { font-size: 22px; margin: 30px 0 10px; line-height: 1.25; }
    .eyebrow { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }
    .lede { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; margin-bottom: 22px; }
    p.body { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; }
    .welcome {
      min-height: calc(100dvh - 100px);
      gap: 14px;
      padding-bottom: 16px;
      padding-top: 30px;
    }
    .welcome h1 { font-size: 42px; line-height: 1.06; letter-spacing: -0.028em; }
    .welcome .lede { font-size: 16px; max-width: 100%; }
    .welcome .wave { font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 11px; }
    .welcome .quick-facts {
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    .welcome .cta-row { gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .sec { margin-top: 42px; }
    .sec-eyebrow { font-size: 10px; }
    .sec-title { font-size: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.2; }
    .sec-lede { font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 22px; max-width: 100%; }

    /* === Stack components vertically === */
    .hero { flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; align-items: flex-start; }
    .avatar { width: 64px; height: 64px; font-size: 24px; }
    .outcome-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; }
    .image-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .mini-process {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      padding: 14px;
      gap: 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
    }
    .mini-process .step .ds { font-size: 12px; }
    .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 14px; }
    .contact-form { padding: 18px; }
    .contact-form .row { flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
    .calendly-card { padding: 18px; }
    .focus-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
    .actions { gap: 8px; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
    .actions .link-pill { justify-content: center; }
    .pill-list { gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 16px; }

    .meta-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px 20px;
      padding: 16px 0;
      margin: 22px 0 24px;
    }
    .meta-row .meta-cta {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      justify-self: stretch;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-left: 0;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .impact-bar {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      grid-template-areas:
        "lbl val"
        "trk trk";
      gap: 6px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .impact-bar .lbl { grid-area: lbl; }
    .impact-bar .val { grid-area: val; text-align: right; }
    .impact-bar .track { grid-area: trk; height: 8px; }
    .impact-chart { padding: 14px; }

    .projects-list-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 18px;
    }
    .pl-card { padding: 16px; }
    .pl-card .pl-thumb { aspect-ratio: 16 / 8; font-size: 16px; }
    .pl-card .pl-title { font-size: 16px; }
    .pl-card .pl-tag { font-size: 13px; }

    /* Hero artwork — vertical, taller on mobile */
    .artwork {
      aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
      border-radius: 18px;
      font-size: 28px;
      max-width: 100%;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 12px 0 24px;
    }

    .bleed-left {
      margin-left: 0;
      margin-right: 0;
      width: 100%;
      padding-left: 0;
      padding-right: 0;
    }

    .image-placeholder { padding: 18px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; margin: 12px 0; }
    .image-placeholder.wide { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }
    .image-placeholder.tall { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }

    /* === "How I work" — horizontal scroll snap on mobile === */
    .process-flow {
      display: flex !important;
      grid-template-columns: none !important;
      gap: 12px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      overflow-y: hidden;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      /* Extend to viewport edges so cards can scroll edge-to-edge,
         but inset the actual card start by 28px so the first card
         doesn't touch the screen border. */
      margin: 4px -20px 0;
      padding: 4px 28px 16px;
      scroll-padding-left: 28px;
      scroll-padding-right: 28px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
    }
    .process-flow::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .process-flow::before { display: none; }
    .process-step {
      flex: 0 0 76%;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--divider);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 18px 16px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      text-align: left;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .process-step .num { width: 44px; height: 44px; font-size: 16px; }
    .process-step .label { font-size: 14px; }
    .process-step .desc { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }

    .contact-meta { gap: 10px; flex-direction: column; }

    /* === Previous / Next on the SAME ROW on mobile === */
    .panel-nav-hint {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: row;
      align-items: stretch;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 36px;
    }
    .panel-nav-hint .nav-side { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; }
    .panel-nav-hint .nav-side .name {
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .panel-nav-hint .nav-side.nav-right { text-align: right; }
  }

  @media (max-width: 480px) {
    .welcome h1 { font-size: 36px; line-height: 1.06; }
    h1.title { font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.14; }
    .lede { font-size: 15px; }
    .sec-title { font-size: 20px; }
    .meta-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px 18px; }
    .artwork { font-size: 22px; }
    .process-step { flex: 0 0 82%; }
  }

</style>
</head>
<body>

        document.body.classList.add('nav-minimized');
      } else if (delta < -MIN_SCROLL_TO_TRIGGER) {
        // scrolling up → expand
        document.body.classList.remove('nav-minimized');
      }
      lastScrollTop = st;
      ticking = false;
    }

    function schedule() {
      if (ticking) return;
      ticking = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(onPanelScroll);
    }

        if (getActiveScroller() === panel) {
          schedule();
        } else {
          lastScrollTop = panel.scrollTop;
        }
      }, { passive: true });
    });

    // Reset baseline when the active scroller changes (tab switch, project open/close)

      const s = getActiveScroller();
      lastScrollTop = s ? s.scrollTop : 0;
      document.body.classList.remove('nav-minimized');

    openProjectMobile = function(id) { _open(id); resetBaseline(); };
    const _close = closeProjectMobile;
    closeProjectMobile = function() { _close(); resetBaseline(); };

    // Also reset on tab change via bn-tab clicks
    document.querySelectorAll('.bn-tab').forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => setTimeout(resetBaseline, 50), { passive: true });
    });

    let axisIsX = false;

      const t = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;

      trackingPanel = openProjectPanel;
      startX = lastX = t.clientX;
      startY = t.clientY;
      startT = lastT = performance.now();
      axisLocked = false;
      axisIsX = false;
      trackingPanel.classList.add('is-dragging');
    }

    function onMove(e) {

            trackingPanel.classList.remove('is-dragging');

      lastX = t.clientX;

      if (!trackingPanel) return;
      const panel = trackingPanel;
      trackingPanel = null;
      panel.classList.remove('is-dragging');

      const dx = lastX - startX;
      const dt = Math.max(1, lastT - startT);
      const velocity = dx / dt;
      const width = panel.offsetWidth || window.innerWidth;
      const commit = dx > width * COMMIT_RATIO || velocity > COMMIT_VELOCITY;

      // Clear inline transform so CSS transition takes over
      panel.style.transform = '';
      if (commit) {
        closeProjectMobile();
      }
      // If not committing, removing the inline transform animates it back.
    }

    document.addEventListener('touchstart', onStart, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener('touchend', onEnd, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('touchcancel', onEnd, { passive: true });
  })();

  // If the viewport changes from mobile to desktop while a project is open,
  // close the overlay so we don't end up in a weird state.
  mobileMQ.addEventListener('change', e => {
    if (!e.matches && openProjectPanel) {
      closeProjectMobile();
    }
  });

  // Contact form: hand off to user's mail client + show inline confirmation
  window.handleContactSubmit = function(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.target;
    const name = encodeURIComponent(form.name.value || '');
    const email = encodeURIComponent(form.email.value || '');
    const subject = encodeURIComponent(form.subject.value || 'Hello from your portfolio');
    const message = encodeURIComponent(
      (form.message.value || '') +
      '\n\n— ' + (form.name.value || '') +
      '\n' + (form.email.value || '')
    );
    const mailto = `mailto:filipe.eck@gmail.com?subject=${subject}&body=${message}`;
    window.location.href = mailto;
    document.getElementById('formSuccess').classList.add('show');
    return false;
  };

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    // On mobile, tab state is managed manually by user clicks — don't let
    // intersection events flip it under the user's feet.
    if (isMobile()) return;
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0.5) {
        setActive(entry.target.dataset.id);
      }
    });
  }, {
    root: content,
    threshold: [0.5, 0.75]
  });
  panels.forEach(p => observer.observe(p));

  function updateScrolled() {
    const horizontallyOffStart = content.scrollLeft > 4;
    const anyVerticallyScrolled = panels.some(p => p.scrollTop > 4);
    document.body.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', horizontallyOffStart || anyVerticallyScrolled);
  }
  content.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrolled, { passive: true });
  panels.forEach(p => p.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrolled, { passive: true }));

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;
    // Escape closes a project overlay on mobile
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && openProjectPanel) {
      closeProjectMobile();
      return;
    }
    const activeIdx = order.findIndex(id => sidebarItems.find(s => s.dataset.target === id && s.classList.contains('active')));
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && activeIdx < order.length - 1) {
      scrollToTarget(order[activeIdx + 1]); setActive(order[activeIdx + 1]);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && activeIdx > 0) {
      scrollToTarget(order[activeIdx - 1]); setActive(order[activeIdx - 1]);
    }
  });

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    scrollToTarget('about');
    setActive('about');
  });

  /* ===== Active panel + parallax on horizontal scroll ===== */
  function getSnapOffsetPx() {
    const v = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
      .getPropertyValue('--snap-offset')
      .trim();
    // calc() values aren't resolved by getComputedStyle on :root vars in
    // every engine, so fall back to a measured value from the spacer.
    const parsed = parseFloat(v);
    if (!isNaN(parsed) && v.endsWith('px')) return parsed;
    const spacer = document.querySelector('.content-spacer');
    return spacer ? spacer.offsetWidth : 0;
  }

  let snapOffsetCached = getSnapOffsetPx();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    snapOffsetCached = getSnapOffsetPx();
    requestAnimationFrame(applyParallax);
  });

  function syncActivePanelClass() {
    const cw = content.clientWidth;
    const sl = content.scrollLeft;
    let bestIdx = 0;
    let bestOverlap = -1;
    panels.forEach((p, i) => {
      const pl = p.offsetLeft;
      const pr = pl + p.offsetWidth;
      const overlap = Math.max(0, Math.min(pr, sl + cw) - Math.max(pl, sl));
      if (overlap > bestOverlap) {
        bestOverlap = overlap;
        bestIdx = i;
      }
    });
    panels.forEach((p, i) => p.classList.toggle('active', i === bestIdx));
  }

  // Parallax: outgoing panel lags behind (deceleration / repulsion feel),
  // incoming panel slides in slightly delayed too. Multiple layers move at
  // different rates so it feels like depth instead of one rigid block.
  function applyParallax() {
    // No horizontal scroll on mobile — clear any leftover transforms and skip.
    if (isMobile()) {
      panels.forEach(panel => {
        const inner = panel.querySelector('.panel-inner');
        if (inner) inner.style.transform = '';
        const artwork = panel.querySelector('.artwork');
        if (artwork) artwork.style.transform = '';
        const title = panel.querySelector('h1.title, h1.page-title, .welcome h1');
        if (title) title.style.transform = '';
      });
      return;
    }
    const sl = content.scrollLeft;
    panels.forEach(panel => {
      if (!panel.offsetWidth) return; // hidden
      const inner = panel.querySelector('.panel-inner');
      if (!inner) return;

      const pl = panel.offsetLeft;
      const pw = panel.offsetWidth;
      const visibleLeft = pl - sl;
      const offset = visibleLeft - snapOffsetCached; // 0 when current

      // Normalised distance (-1 .. 1 across one panel width either side)
      const t = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, offset / pw));
      // ease-out cubic so deceleration is gentle as a panel approaches
      // its snap position from either direction
      const eased = t < 0
        ? -(1 - Math.pow(1 + t, 3))
        :  (1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3));
      // Inner lag — outgoing translates right (positive), upcoming left
      const innerLag = -eased * 70;
      inner.style.transform = `translate3d(${innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;

      // Differential parallax on the artwork (moves slightly faster than
      // surrounding text — creates a subtle depth effect)
      const artwork = panel.querySelector('.artwork');
      if (artwork) {
        const artLag = -eased * 110;
        artwork.style.transform = `translate3d(${artLag - innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;
      }
      // Title nudges in the opposite direction for visual punch
      const title = panel.querySelector('h1.title, h1.page-title, .welcome h1');
      if (title) {
        const titleLag = -eased * 40;
        title.style.transform = `translate3d(${titleLag - innerLag}px, 0, 0)`;
      }
    });
  }

  let parallaxRAF = null;
  function scheduleScrollUpdate() {
    if (parallaxRAF) return;
    parallaxRAF = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      syncActivePanelClass();
      applyParallax();
      parallaxRAF = null;
    });
  }
  content.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleScrollUpdate, { passive: true });
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    syncActivePanelClass();
    applyParallax();
  });

  /* ===== Scroll reveal observer ===== */
  function setupReveal() {
    const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' });
    revealEls.forEach(el => io.observe(el));

    // Per-panel vertical reveal
    panels.forEach(panel => {
      const items = panel.querySelectorAll('.sec, .focus-card, .skill, .process-step, .image-placeholder, .image-row, .outcome-card, .impact-bar, .mini-process .step, .contact-form, .calendly-card');
      const panelIO = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
            panelIO.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { root: panel, threshold: 0.18 });
      items.forEach(el => { el.classList.add('reveal'); panelIO.observe(el); });
    });
  }
  setupReveal();

  /* ===== Initial loader ===== */
  function hideLoader() {
    const loader = document.getElementById('loader');
    if (!loader) return;
    loader.classList.add('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => { loader.style.display = 'none'; }, 700);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    setTimeout(hideLoader, 900);
  });
  // Fallback in case 'load' already fired
  if (document.readyState === 'complete') setTimeout(hideLoader, 900);

  /* ===== iPadOS-style custom cursor ===== */
  (function initCursor() {
    if (window.matchMedia('(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)').matches) return;
    const shape = document.getElementById('cursorShape');
    const dot = document.getElementById('cursorDot');
    if (!shape || !dot) return;

    let mouseX = window.innerWidth / 2;
    let mouseY = window.innerHeight / 2;
    let shapeX = mouseX, shapeY = mouseY;
    let targetW = 28, targetH = 28, targetR = 50;
    let curW = 28, curH = 28, curR = 50;
    let hoverEl = null;
    let lockToEl = false;

    // Only truly clickable / focusable elements morph the cursor
    const interactiveSel = [
      'a[href]',
      'button',
      'input:not([type="hidden"])',
      'textarea',
      'select',
      '.sidebar-item',
      '.focus-card',
      '.link-pill',
      '.social-btn',
      '.nav-side',
      '.cal-btn',
      '.project-card',
      '.bn-tab',
      '[data-target]:not(.process-step)',
      '[data-scroll-to]',
      '[role="button"]'
    ].join(', ');

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      mouseX = e.clientX;
      mouseY = e.clientY;
      dot.style.left = mouseX + 'px';
      dot.style.top = mouseY + 'px';

      const target = e.target.closest(interactiveSel);
      if (target && target !== hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = target;
        const r = target.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Hug the element fully — no caps. Add a small padding so the cursor
        // sits a couple of pixels outside the element's edges.
        targetW = r.width + 8;
        targetH = r.height + 8;
        // Match element's border-radius where possible
        const cs = getComputedStyle(target);
        let br = parseFloat(cs.borderRadius);
        if (isNaN(br) || br === 0) br = 12;
        const cap = Math.min(targetW, targetH) / 2;
        if (br > cap) br = cap;
        targetR = br;
        shape.classList.add('on-element');
        lockToEl = true;
        // Snap shape to element center for smooth morph
        shapeX = r.left + r.width / 2;
        shapeY = r.top + r.height / 2;
      } else if (!target && hoverEl) {
        hoverEl = null;
        targetW = 22;
        targetH = 22;
        targetR = 50;
        shape.classList.remove('on-element');
        lockToEl = false;
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      document.body.classList.add('cursor-hidden');
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('cursor-hidden');
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
      shape.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.92)';
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      shape.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
    });

    function tick() {
      // Smoothly approach target dimensions
      curW += (targetW - curW) * 0.22;
      curH += (targetH - curH) * 0.22;
      curR += (targetR - curR) * 0.22;

      if (lockToEl && hoverEl && document.contains(hoverEl)) {
        const r = hoverEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Slight magnetic offset toward mouse position within element
        const cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
        const cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
        const offX = (mouseX - cx) * 0.18;
        const offY = (mouseY - cy) * 0.18;
        shapeX += ((cx + offX) - shapeX) * 0.35;
        shapeY += ((cy + offY) - shapeY) * 0.35;
      } else {
        shapeX += (mouseX - shapeX) * 0.22;
        shapeY += (mouseY - shapeY) * 0.22;
      }

      shape.style.width = curW + 'px';
      shape.style.height = curH + 'px';
      // Use percentage of smaller side to keep border-radius proportional
      if (targetR >= 50 - 0.5) {
        shape.style.borderRadius = '50%';
      } else {
        shape.style.borderRadius = curR + 'px';
      }
      shape.style.left = shapeX + 'px';
      shape.style.top = shapeY + 'px';

      // Dot fades slightly when on a button-like element for cleaner look
      dot.classList.toggle('faded', lockToEl);

      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    tick();
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>
